exercises.problemHtml:
What pg_trgm does, and when to use it instead of full-text search.

This set has 3 questions. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. Work each one out yourself first (on paper or in psql on your own PostgreSQL), then check — every explanation after Submit says why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanation of every question appears after you submit.

# Trigrams in one page — answer key

1. show_trgm('cat') returns…show_trgm('cat') trả về…
   Answer: b) {" c"," ca","at ",cat} — padded 3-letter windows
   Words are padded with two spaces in front and one behind, then cut into every 3-character window.VI: Từ được đệm hai dấu cách phía trước và một phía sau, rồi cắt thành mọi cửa sổ 3 ký tự.

2. Which search needs pg_trgm rather than full-text search?Kiểu tìm nào cần pg_trgm thay vì full-text search?
   Answer: a) a typo-tolerant search on product names ("casoi" → Casio)
   FTS matches whole words (stemmed); trigrams measure character overlap, so they survive typos and partial words.VI: FTS khớp nguyên từ (đã đưa về gốc); trigram đo độ trùng ký tự nên chịu được gõ sai và từ dở dang.

3. Why does ILIKE '%index%' become fast with a GIN gin_trgm_ops index?Vì sao ILIKE '%index%' nhanh lên với chỉ mục GIN gin_trgm_ops?
   Answer: d) the pattern is cut into trigrams; rows holding all of them are rechecked
   B-trees cannot help a leading wildcard; a trigram index can, because every substring of length ≥ 3 is made of indexed trigrams.VI: B-tree không giúp được ký tự đại diện ở đầu; chỉ mục trigram thì được, vì mọi chuỗi con dài ≥ 3 đều ghép từ các trigram đã đánh chỉ mục.

exercises.title: pg_trgm on your own PostgreSQL: typos and a fast ILIKE
exercises.problemHtml:
Run lesson 13.4 on your PostgreSQL 17 (the article table of lesson 13.3):

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;

-- typo tolerance
SELECT similarity('PostgreSQL', 'PostgresSQL') AS close, similarity('PostgreSQL', 'MySQL') AS far;
SELECT title, round(similarity(title, 'postgres indexs')::numeric, 3) AS score
FROM article WHERE title % 'postgres indexs' ORDER BY score DESC;

-- ILIKE '%…%' that uses an index
CREATE INDEX article_title_trgm ON article USING GIN (title gin_trgm_ops);
EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM article WHERE title ILIKE '%index%';

Runs on YOUR machine, not in the browser. pg_trgm is an extension; the browser grader runs core PostgreSQL only and cannot load extensions. Nothing here is graded automatically: do the steps in your own PostgreSQL, compare with the expected output, then press Mark as solved.

Requirements

  • similarity('PostgreSQL', 'PostgresSQL') is high (about 0.7), MySQL low.
  • The typo query finds "PostgreSQL indexing basics".
  • After the index, EXPLAIN of the ILIKE shows a Bitmap Index Scan on article_title_trgm (on a big enough table, or with enable_seqscan = off).
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Chạy bài 13.4 trên PostgreSQL 17 của bạn (bảng article của bài 13.3):

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;

-- typo tolerance
SELECT similarity('PostgreSQL', 'PostgresSQL') AS close, similarity('PostgreSQL', 'MySQL') AS far;
SELECT title, round(similarity(title, 'postgres indexs')::numeric, 3) AS score
FROM article WHERE title % 'postgres indexs' ORDER BY score DESC;

-- ILIKE '%…%' that uses an index
CREATE INDEX article_title_trgm ON article USING GIN (title gin_trgm_ops);
EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM article WHERE title ILIKE '%index%';

Chạy trên MÁY CỦA BẠN, không chạy trong trình duyệt. pg_trgm là một extension; máy chấm trình duyệt chỉ chạy PostgreSQL lõi và không nạp được extension. Trang này không tự chấm: làm các bước trên PostgreSQL của bạn, so với output mong đợi, rồi bấm Tự đánh dấu đã giải.

Yêu cầu

  • similarity('PostgreSQL', 'PostgresSQL') cao (khoảng 0.7), MySQL thấp.
  • Truy vấn gõ sai vẫn tìm ra "PostgreSQL indexing basics".
  • Sau khi có chỉ mục, EXPLAIN của ILIKE hiện Bitmap Index Scan trên article_title_trgm (với bảng đủ lớn, hoặc enable_seqscan = off).

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

CREATE FUNCTION plan_nodes(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json; out text := '';
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, COSTS OFF) ' || q INTO j;
  WITH RECURSIVE n(p) AS (SELECT j -> 0 -> 'Plan' UNION ALL SELECT x FROM n, json_array_elements(n.p -> 'Plans') x)
  SELECT string_agg((p ->> 'Node Type') || coalesce(' on ' || (p ->> 'Index Name'), ''), ' / ') INTO out FROM n;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_text(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_rows(q text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json;
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) ' || q INTO j;
  RETURN (j -> 0 -> 'Plan' ->> 'Plan Rows')::numeric::bigint;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_analyze(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF, BUFFERS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

DECLARE j json; out text := '';
